acceptance: Baseline is smallest actually validated same-service-program layout, not claimed theoretical minimum
Excess requires verified functional reason and alternative comparison; missing baseline=unknown
Do not shrink required activities to meet a percentage
Prove necessary common access and staging; merely leftover between stair and lift is not justified
Compare compact actual same-program alternative with preserved operational access
Balance unit access by comparing distance spread, not arbitrary equality tolerance
Full technical stair/elevator approval is excluded; geometric ownership and actual access remain in scope

Q04.measured: declared circulation union and actual all-target lengths/turns

IR_P13.measured: per-bedroom source target to entry and WC via entry route lengths

SERVICE_COMPACTNESS.measured: tested B18 room-area baseline and zero/nonzero excess independently each unit

COMMON_CORE_COMPACTNESS.measured: common areas,actual entry access length/turns and per-unit distance spread
